paragraphs: Rabbi Hoshaya said, “I was a chaver, and Rabbi Shmuel bar Rav Yitzchak brought me into the sanctification of the month. I do not know whether I counted toward the number.” Plainly he did not, because he was Rabbi Shmuel’s son-in-law, Jerusalem Talmud, Sanhedrin, first chapter, halakhah 2.
